headline: Hotel operations + technology
description: Hands-on experience in front office, reservations and accommodation operations, combined with technical training in web development. I know PMS, OTAs, pricing and the day-to-day running of a hotel from the inside. Now I want to bring that perspective to Hotel Tech, Customer Success and Implementation teams.
imageAlt: Illustration of the professional profile surrounded by the elements of the role: a hotel, the PMS connected to Booking.com, Expedia and Airbnb, an analytics dashboard, digital keys, languages and the implementation, onboarding and success flow.
